# ContourSurface3DElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasContourSurface3DElement` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasContourSurface3D.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasContourSurface3D.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasContourSurface3D.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A scalar field: isolines and filled bands, or a shaded 3D height field

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasContourSurface3DElement> CreateContourSurface3DElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasContourSurface3DElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### enum `SurfaceColorMode`

How the surface is coloured.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Banded` | one flat colour per contour band (the Excel look) |
| `Smooth` | continuous colour-map value per quad |

### enum `SurfaceLegendMode`

Legend placement for the colour key (drawn by the shared ChartLegend).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoLegend` |  |
| `Horizontal` | a horizontal colour bar under the plot |
| `Vertical` | a vertical colour bar on the right |
